description: Every capability a connector manifest declares (connectors/<type>/<code>/connector.yaml) must have a pm-core consumer that routes on it (FSD §15, §12). Key: '<type>/<code>:<capability>'.

idpi/oidc:claims_to_roles.notes: ResolveClaimsToRoles from the mapping file; pm-core consumer: platform roles and approver pools on login (4b, closes B-09). Disposition planned until pm-core routes on it.

idpi/oidc:interactive_login.notes: Authorization-code login (AuthenticateInteractive + CompleteAuthentication). pm-core consumer: the login routes of slice 4b. Disposition planned until pm-core routes on it.

idpi/oidc:logout.notes: Revocation plus end-session URL; pm-core consumer: logout cascade (4b). Disposition planned until pm-core routes on it.

idpi/oidc:pkce.notes: PKCE S256 on the code flow; pm-core keeps the verifier server-side. Disposition planned until pm-core routes on it.

idpi/oidc:token_refresh.notes: RefreshToken; pm-core consumer: sliding sessions (4b). Disposition planned until pm-core routes on it.

idpi/oidc:token_validation.notes: ValidateToken against the IdP JWKS; pm-core consumer: session validation (4b). Disposition planned until pm-core routes on it.
